scope: Idealized own-two-dense-root-ribs beam section screen. 20 N directional force plus 5 N own-key downward weight. Connected-v3 analytic hulls, 1.3-5 mm front-of-board sections. No surrounding skins/other dense masks/bulk credited. Plane-section compatibility assumed. Torsion, local contact, root stress concentrations, pegs, buckling and true interlayer stresses unassessed. Not a complete-holder safety factor or a guaranteed conservative bound.
